name: Neeed Directory

sources.title: Submit your product — Free (badge) vs Premium $19 one-time, plus listing guidelines

conditions: Free listing is live right away after an automatic check, and the backlink becomes dofollow once the neeed badge on your site is verified
Without the verified badge the free link is not dofollow
requirements: Accepted: software (web/mobile apps, SaaS, dev tools, extensions, APIs) and digital products (templates, design assets, courses, ebooks, kits)
Not accepted: adult content, and local service businesses (trades, salons, clinics, single-area agencies)
Every submission passes an automatic check; out-of-scope listings are not published
Sign-in required to fill the form (/sign-in?callbackURL=/submit?plan=free|premium)
preparation: Product name, URL, description, category (large taxonomy incl. AI, Developer Tools, SaaS, Marketing Tools, etc.)
neeed badge placed on your site for the free dofollow conversion

Optional $19 one-time Premium: permanent dofollow without badge, enhanced profile (highlights, who-it's-for, FAQ), FAQ schema, 7 days in 'Just launched' homepage + top-of-category, Premium page feature
workflow: Pick Free or Premium on /submit, then sign in
Free: pass the automatic check → live immediately; add badge → dofollow once verified
Premium: pay $19 once → permanent dofollow + enhanced profile + 7-day 'Just launched' placement
watchFor: Free listing goes live before the badge check completes — dofollow conversion depends on verification succeeding afterwards
Scope rules are enforced by an automatic gate — local service businesses are explicitly excluded
Both tiers are one-time, neither is a subscription
Site exposes llms.txt/llms-full.txt and an API — machine-verifiable once live
countsAsLive: Product page on neeed.directory live immediately after the automatic check, appearing in its category and (for Premium) in 'Just launched' and /premium
unknowns: Whether free listings lose dofollow if the badge is removed later (verification appears ongoing)
What the automatic check validates beyond content scope
